text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after the return is received.
Orders over 50 dollars ship free. Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days within the continental US.
A cancelled order is refunded in full automatically; you do not need to contact support to request it.
To return an item, start a return from the Orders page within 30 days of delivery and print the prepaid label.
International shipping is available to the UK, Netherlands, and Canada, with delivery in 7 to 14 business days.
Gift cards are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash, except where required by law.
